result.summary: Several layout and content clipping issues are visible: truncated restaurant names, cut-off category chips and cards, and partial bottom content. These reduce scannability and make the UI feel unfinished.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off in the Fastest near you row.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size, or ensure cards fully show names (e.g. ellipsis only after full readable width).

issues.description: Category filter chips overflow horizontally with a partial chip visible on the right edge and no clear affordance that the row scrolls.
issues.suggestion: Add fade/scroll hint, padding at end of list, or wrap/scroll cleanly so chips aren’t clipped mid-control.

issues.description: Bottom restaurant card (pizza) is heavily cropped by the screen/tab bar so most of the card and metadata are missing.
issues.suggestion: Ensure list content has enough bottom padding above the tab bar and that cards aren’t cut off mid-image.

issues.description: Fastest near you cards show only a sliver of the third card, which can look broken rather than intentionally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Adjust peek width/spacing or add a clearer horizontal scroll cue so partial cards feel intentional.

issues.description: Promo banner text is low-contrast (light green on light green), which hurts readability.
issues.suggestion: Darken body text or increase contrast against the mint background for WCAG-compliant readability.
